fusions.name: Driving Blaze
fusions.desc: Sweeps a sheet of flame 5 tiles ahead of you that deals 12 fire damage to everything in it, drives them back 3.5 tiles and sets them [Burning] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Marked by Hot Iron
fusions.desc: Presses a brand into the target for 28 fire damage that ignores resistance, sets it [Burning] for 4 damage a second for 6 seconds, and leaves it [Marked] for 15 seconds and 15% easier to wound for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Backburn Line
fusions.desc: Lights a line of flame 6 tiles long for 6 seconds. Anything that crosses it is set [Burning] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Jumping Flame
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, a bolt leaps to the nearest enemy within 5 tiles for 8 damage and sets it [Burning] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds. Once every 6 seconds.
